messages:
kairos-cs: Hey team — we're seeing a spike of 5xx/429s from our dedicated pool (kairos-prod-pool) after a marketing send. Can you triage?

maria-support: can you paste a few example error responses / timestamps?

kairos-cs: sure. most errors are 429 token_throttle or 5xx backend_timeout. window: 2025-11-04T14:02:10Z -> 14:18:00Z. baseline QPS ~1200, sustained peak ~8.6k for ~9m, then back to 1.5k.

alan-sre: 8.6k sustained on a pool sized for 3k baseline no surprise it's throttling. what's the pool slab/instance count?

kairos-cs: pool config: 4 GPUs (p4d-like), autoscale min=4, max=12, target_util=0.75. We observed utilization hit 92% before we started seeing 429s.

jing-ml: autoscaler logs show scale-up triggers at 14:03:05 but nodes didn't finish initializing until ~14:04:20 — autoscale lag ~75s. During that time, requests queue and cause throttles. also seeing heavy KV cache misses after model switches.

alan-sre: hmm. target_util 0.75 + cold start + peak 8.6k => we should've hit max and still be tight. what's per-GPU throughput?

kairos-cs: per-GPU estimated steady QPS for their model (llama-70b-v1-q8) ~1.2k at their average seq len. So 4 GPUs ~4.8k steady. The peak exceeded that.

maria-support: there's also auth noise — customer rotated tokens mid-send and some clients got 401s then retried in a tight loop which inflated request volume. logs show ~15% of requests during spike were reauth/retry bursts.

alan-sre: retries can amplify load massively. any rate-limit headers/timeouts visible?

kairos-cs: yes, responses included Retry-After: 1 and a 401 earlier without backoff in client.

autoscale-bot: [autoscale-event] 14:03:05 trigger -> 14:04:20 nodes_ready=2 added -> pool_nodes=6 (scaling from 4)

jing-ml: quick repro steps I used locally: 1) simulate baseline 1.2k qps; 2) inject 6k burst for 6m; 3) drop 15% of tokens as 401 then immediate retry x3; 4) observe queue growth and 429 at ~60s. included the exact curl ramp script below:

jing-ml: ```bash
# ramp to baseline
wrk -t8 -c200 -d60s --rate 1200 
# inject 6k burst for 6m
wrk -t32 -c1000 -d360s --rate 6000 
# side process simulating token refresh leading to retries
python retry_spammer.py --rate 900 --retry 3
```

maria-support: thanks. customer also reported a billing anomaly where they saw double counting for retries. looks like our billing pipeline counted each retry as chargeable. filing billing ticket after we stabilize.

alan-sre: short-term mitigation: 1) ask customer to pause send or enable client-side backoff; 2) temporarily raise pool max to 18 or increase reserved slab to handle peak; 3) reduce target_util to 0.6 so autoscaler has headroom; 4) apply 429-exponential-backoff advisory to client.

kairos-cs: customer is open to pausing. they want a timeline and cost estimate for temporary slab bump.

alan-sre: ETA if we approve: + increase reserved slab to 8 GPUs (from 4) — infra change ~15m, propagate ~5m, cost estimate attached separately. autoscaler target_util change is config-only, deploy via console ~5m.

jing-ml: medium-term: enable smarter warmup (preload KV cache for common prefixes) + reduce model_loads by pinning to warm instances during campaign windows. also add a token-rotation checklist to avoid mass-401s.

autoscale-bot: [action] created ticket SVC-12984: kairos-prod-pool temporary slab increase + target_util change + billing review

deploy-bot: deploy queued: config change target_util=0.60 -> will roll canary 3 min after approval

maria-support: i'll coordinate customer pause and confirm approval for temporary slab increase. Also opening billing ticket: BILL-4872.

kairos-cs: thanks all. leaving this thread open for post-mortem notes. please add any playbook steps we should formalize. :thumbsup:
